title: SANAD RC3 measured-multipath-derived RF stress tests
input_adapter: incoherent path-power-weighted spatial covariance from measured AoA and complex path weights plus identity receiver noise
base_station_profiles_from: disjoint 300-valid-snapshot segments from three drive routes
fault_injection: Original glr_compare.pipeline: two synthetically faulty array stations per draw, gain 0.3–0.8 dB, phase 3–8 degrees, ramp 80 reporting periods, 3% glitches, 5% missing
caveats: The measured dataset contains 8x8 MIMO channel MPCs, not directly measured multi-station spatial covariance.
M=16,32,64 are covariance reconstructions extrapolated from measured MPC angles; they are not physically captured 16/32/64-element antenna arrays.
Each station is a disjoint mobile route segment, not a simultaneously observed independent base station.
Repeated injected-fault draws reuse the same underlying channel evidence, so the counts do not establish independent confidence bounds.
Measured drive-route samples are not the fixed 15-minute reporting intervals used in original Sionna trials.
Four stations violate the original five-reporting-station reference requirement; preserving original logic prevents the reference stage from activating.
Zero observed false alerts cannot establish a zero field false-alarm rate.
